{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Beans|Beans]]

This is a recipe to cook beans in Instant Pot [[Cookbook:Multicooking|multicooker]].

==Ingredients==
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] dried [[Cookbook:Beans|beans]], picked through
* 8 cups water
* ½ [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], peeled
* 3 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] cloves, peeled
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Ham|Ham]] (optional), diced or chopped
==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Soaking Beans|Soak]] the beans in water for 4–12 hours. Drain the water.
# Place the soaked beans, water, garlic, onion, and ham pieces in the Instant Pot.
# Seal the lid, close the valve, and set the "manual" button to 35 minutes.
# Use a natural pressure release or the quick pressure release ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-hDonz_VPL0 see how]). 
# When the valve drops, carefully remove the lid.
# Season with salt to taste.
# Serve or reuse in other recipes that employs beans.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The "manual" button and "pressure cook" button are the same and so interchangeably named for the different models.
* The longer the beans soak, the less cooking time is required.
* Be sure any beans containing the toxin phytohaemagglutinin (e.g. kidney beans) are thoroughly cooked to prevent toxicity.
